

❯ Create a file named w.txt containing the single word hello. Use the Write tool.

⏺ Write(w.txt)
  ⎿  Wrote 1 line to w.txt
      1 hello

⏺ I created /tmp/project/w.txt with the single word hello using the Write tool.

  ★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────
  Write creates the file, or replaces it entirely if it already exists. It doesn't append. That's why I passed the exact
  content hello with no trailing newline. If you want one, add it to the content.
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
